Bower is part of 6 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2025.

What it was for: [Web](@/projects/web.md) (4), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [korczis-com](@/work/korczis-com.md): korczis.com website; [web-spa](@/work/web-spa.md): Single Page Application written in Elm with Elixir/Phoenix Backend; [pavian.eu](@/work/pavian-eu.md): pavian.eu website.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Bower: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Bower to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
